 Job Description: 
 Transform technology into opportunity as a Power BI Developer at GDIT. Shape what’s next for mission-critical government projects while shaping what’s next for your engineering career.

 MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT
 As a Power BI Developer, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of our customers. You will play a crucial role in: 

 Designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining enterprise business intelligence solutions using Microsoft Power BI
 Developing interactive dashboards, reports, visualizations, and analytical solutions that provide actionable insights to business and technical stakeholders
 Gathering and translating business and reporting requirements into scalable and reusable Power BI solutions
 Developing semantic models, relationships, measures, calculated columns, and other analytical components using DAX
 Using Power Query and M language to transform, cleanse, integrate, and prepare data for reporting and analytics
 Connecting Power BI solutions to enterprise data sources, including SQL Server, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Dataverse, Excel, APIs, and other structured data sources
 Designing efficient data models using dimensional modeling and star-schema principles to support enterprise reporting and analytics
 Developing and optimizing SQL queries, views, and data transformations used by Power BI solutions
 Configuring and implementing row-level security (RLS) and other report and dataset access controls
 Publishing and managing reports, semantic models, dashboards, and applications within the Power BI Service
 Configuring and troubleshooting data refreshes, data gateways, connections, and scheduled refresh processes
 Monitoring and optimizing Power BI report, semantic model, and query performance
 Supporting deployment and promotion of Power BI solutions across development, test, and production environments
 Performing unit and integration testing and supporting user acceptance testing (UAT)
 Troubleshooting and resolving issues with reports, data models, data quality, refreshes, gateways, and data-source connectivity
 Developing and maintaining technical documentation, data definitions, report specifications, and solution documentation
 Collaborating with business analysts, developers, administrators, architects, data teams, and stakeholders throughout the solution development lifecycle
 Presenting analytical findings, dashboards, and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
 Providing technical guidance and knowledge support to end users and junior staff
 
 WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED 
 Bring your engineering expertise along with a drive for innovation to GDIT. The Power BI Developer must have: 

 Education: BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field required

 Experience: 
 3+ years of experience designing, developing, testing, and deploying business intelligence and analytics solutions required
 Hands-on experience developing enterprise reports, dashboards, semantic models, and analytical solutions using Microsoft Power BI
 Experience integrating and transforming data from multiple enterprise data sources
 
 Required Skills 
 Strong proficiency with Microsoft Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service
 Strong proficiency with DAX for measures, calculations, and analytical logic
 Strong proficiency with Power Query and M for data transformation and preparation
 Experience designing semantic models, relationships, hierarchies, measures, and calculated columns
 Experience with dimensional data modeling and star-schema design
 Strong SQL skills, including developing and optimizing queries used for reporting and analytics
 Experience integrating Power BI with SQL Server, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Dataverse, Excel, APIs, and other enterprise data sources
 Experience implementing row-level security (RLS) and managing access to Power BI content
 Experience publishing and managing reports, semantic models, dashboards, workspaces, and Power BI applications
 Experience configuring and troubleshooting scheduled refreshes, data connections, and on-premises data gateways
 Ability to troubleshoot and optimize Power BI report, semantic model, DAX, and query performance
 Understanding of data quality, data validation, and reporting governance principles
 Experience supporting deployment of Power BI solutions across development, test, and production environments
 Familiarity with Power BI deployment pipelines and source/version control practices
 Familiarity with Agile methodology
 Ability to translate business and reporting requirements into scalable, maintainable, and reusable technical solutions
 Ability to communicate complex data and analytical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Excellent communication skills
 Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment
 Ability to provide technical guidance and knowledge support to junior staff
 Willingness to stay current on Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and emerging analytics technologies
 
 Required Certification(s) 
 Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400 or AB-400)
 ITIL v4 or v5 Foundation
 
 Security Clearance Level: Must be able to pass a background check to obtain a position of Public Trust
 
 Location: Remote

 GDIT IS YOUR PLACE 
 At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do. 

 ● Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
 ● Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
 ● Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off
 ● Flexibility: Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home
 ● Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

 OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY 

 Explore a career in software development at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your dedication to advancing innovation.

 #GDITLA 
 
 
The likely salary range for this position is $76,565 - $92,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

 Total Rewards at GDIT: 
Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.  
  

 Our Identity Verification Process: 
As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.  
  
 About Our Work: 
We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. We operate across 50+ countries worldwide, offering leading mission-ready capabilities in AI, cloud, cyber and software development. 
 
Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on our career opportunities and events at gdit.com/tc .
 
 
 
Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans
